title: API Token Controls
scope: Admin controls, logging and revocation for API credentials on SaaS platforms. Sourced from vendor documentation; not an audit of any tenant.

definitions.conditional: Documented, with plan, policy or endpoint conditions.
definitions.excluded: The named control explicitly does not cover this credential.
definitions.not_supported: Vendor documentation states this credential lacks the control.
definitions.unknown: No source found either way. Not a negative finding.
definitions.not_verified: No source found either way. Not a negative finding.
definitions.not_applicable: Does not apply to this credential.
definitions.limited: Documented for a narrower case only.

providers.name: OpenText Cloud Platform
providers.scope_notes: Covers OpenText Cloud Platform (Admin Center / Thrust Services APIs, used by OpenText Core SaaS apps such as Core Content). Covers the OAuth service clients and tokens of OpenText Cloud Platform (formerly OT2 / Developer Cloud), which back Core Content and other Core SaaS APIs at <region>.api.opentext.com; on-prem Content Server/OTDS and Admin Center help (CDAC-H-*) pages are not covered.

controls.name: Revoke client
controls.what: Revokes access tokens for a confidential service client.
controls.setting: Admin Center > Service clients > More options > Revoke client

controls.name: Edit token lifetimes
controls.what: Sets access (900-28800 s) and refresh (900 s-1 year) token lifetimes per client.
controls.setting: Admin Center > Service clients > More options > Edit token lifetimes; Admin API Client.accessTokenLifetime / refreshTokenLifetime

controls.name: Deactivate service client (activate=false)
controls.what: Deactivates an app or organization service client through the Admin API.

controls.name: allowedScopes
controls.what: Lists the scopes a client may request.

controls.name: Redirect URLs
controls.what: Only registered redirect URLs can receive authorization codes.
controls.setting: Admin Center > Service clients > Redirect URLs

no_control.what: Public clients cannot be revoked or regenerated in Admin Center (only confidential clients can).

controls_unknown: Audit log for OpenText Cloud Platform / Admin Center: event names for client create, regenerate, revoke and token issuance; retention; how to export.
Whether API calls or data reads (e.g. Core Content GET /v3/files) are logged and which field identifies the client.
Whether client secrets expire or can be given an expiry.
Any IP/network restriction on service clients or tokens.
Whether 'Revoke client' invalidates already-issued access tokens immediately, and whether it also invalidates the secret.
Default token lifetimes when not edited (Core Capture sample shows 900 s).
Whether the password grant can be disabled per tenant, and whether IdP MFA applies to it.

auth_paths.name: User access/refresh tokens via authorization code (confidential) or PKCE (public client)

authentication.summary: Users sign in through the tenant oauth2/auth endpoint (and the tenant's authentication handler, e.g. SAML to Okta/Google), and the app exchanges the code for access, refresh and ID tokens. Public clients use PKCE and have no secret.

federation.details: The interactive sign-in goes through the tenant's configured authentication scheme (e.g. SAML IdP). Whether refresh tokens are re-checked against the IdP is not documented.

lifetime.summary: Refresh token up to 1 year; access 900-28800 s

administration.summary: Redirect URLs must be registered per client (up to three for tenant clients). Revoke client and Regenerate exist only for confidential clients; public clients can be deactivated via the Admin API.

token_format.notes: Opaque bearer token per docs; format not documented.

anomaly_cues: Long refresh token lifetimes (up to 1 year)

containment.steps: Revoke the confidential client; for public clients deactivate via Admin API activate=false; disable the user.
containment.notes: Docs say Revoke client revokes an access token but do not state scope or timing.

unknown: Audit event names and log location
